# buddy_sandbox (Resource)

Create and manage a sandbox

Token scopes required: `SANDBOX_READ`, `SANDBOX_WRITE`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "buddy_sandbox" "sb" {
  domain              = "mydomain"
  project_name        = "test"
  name                = "sb"
  install_commands    = "apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl"
  wait_for_running    = true
  wait_for_configured = true
  endpoints = {
    "local" = {
      endpoint = "localhost:3333"
      type     = "HTTP"
    }
  }
}
resource "buddy_sandbox" "fetch" {
  domain              = "mydomain"
  project_name        = "test"
  name                = "fetch"
  wait_for_running    = true
  wait_for_configured = true

  app {
    identifier = "web"
    command    = "npm run dev"
    path       = "/app"
  }

  fetch {
    type          = "PROJECT_REPO"
    ref           = "main"
    path          = "/app"
    build_command = "npm ci"
  }

  fetch {
    type       = "PUBLIC_REPO"
    repository = "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World"
    path       = "/vendor/hello-world"
  }

  fetch {
    type        = "ARTIFACT"
    artifact    = "my-artifact:latest"
    source_path = "dist.zip"
    path        = "/data"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle
- `name` (String) The sandbox's name

### Optional

- `agent_note` (String) The sandbox's agent note
- `app` (Block List) The sandbox's app. Conflicts with `app_commands` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--app))
- `app_commands` (Set of String) The sandbox's app commands. Conflicts with `app` blocks
- `app_dir` (String) The sandbox's app dir
- `endpoints` (Attributes Map) The sandbox's map of endpoints (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `environment_id` (String) The environment's id. Conflicts with `project_name`
- `fetch` (Block List) The source (repository or artifact) to fetch into the sandbox. Changing the blocks replaces the whole list, every fetch is then fetched again (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--fetch))
- `identifier` (String) The sandbox's identifier
- `install_commands` (String) The sandbox's install commands
- `note` (String) The sandbox's note
- `os` (String) The sandbox's operating system
- `permissions` (Block Set) The sandbox's permissions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))
- `project_name` (String) The project's name. Conflicts with `environment_id` - a sandbox belongs either to a project or to an environment, and an environment already carries its own project
- `resources` (String) The sandbox's resources (cpu, ram)
- `tags` (Set of String) The sandbox's list of tags
- `timeout` (Number) The sandbox's start timeout
- `wait_for_apps` (Boolean) Wait until sandbox running apps commands
- `wait_for_apps_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait until sandbox ran apps commands
- `wait_for_configured` (Boolean) Wait until sandbox ran setup commands
- `wait_for_configured_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait until sandbox ran setup commands
- `wait_for_running` (Boolean) Wait until sandbox is running
- `wait_for_running_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait until sandbox is running

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes Set) The sandbox's apps (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `boot_logs` (String) The sandbox's boot logs
- `create_date` (String) The sandbox's creation date
- `fetches` (Attributes List) The sources fetched into the sandbox, as returned by the API (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fetches))
- `html_url` (String) The sandbox's URL
- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item
- `sandbox_id` (String) The sandbox's ID
- `scope` (String) The sandbox's scope: `PROJECT`, `ENVIRONMENT` or `WORKSPACE`
- `setup_status` (String) The sandbox's setup status
- `ssh_host` (String) The sandbox's SSH host
- `ssh_port` (Number) The sandbox's SSH port
- `status` (String) The sandbox's status

<a id="nestedblock--fetch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fetch`

Required:

- `type` (String) The fetch's type. Allowed: `PROJECT_REPO`, `PUBLIC_REPO`, `ARTIFACT`

Optional:

- `artifact` (String) The artifact in format `name:version`. Provide for `ARTIFACT`
- `build_command` (String) The command run after fetching
- `path` (String) The target directory in the sandbox. Defaults to the sandbox's `app_dir`. Two fetches cannot share it
- `ref` (String) The branch, tag or commit to checkout. Defaults to the default branch. Provide for `PROJECT_REPO`, `PUBLIC_REPO`
- `repository` (String) The URL of the git repository. Provide for `PUBLIC_REPO`
- `source_path` (String) The path inside the artifact to fetch instead of its whole content. Provide for `ARTIFACT`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using domain(mydomain), sandbox_id(1234)
terraform import buddy_sandbox.mysandbox mydomain:1234
```
